patch_description: The previous diff failed to apply, so this attempt replaces the placeholder solver with a self-contained, deterministic heuristic for the n=13 Heilbronn triangle problem. Strategy: multi-start greedy local search. Points live in the unit square (a convex region of unit area), so the normalized score equals the minimum triangle area. All 286 triangle areas are computed vectorized via precomputed index triples and 2D cross products. From multiple fixed-seed initializations (random plus a Sobol-like jittered grid), each point is repeatedly perturbed with a decaying step size, accepting only strict improvements to the minimal triangle area. A time budget guards efficiency. The best configuration across all restarts is returned, guaranteeing determinism (fixed `default_rng` seed, no wall-clock-dependent branching that changes the output beyond the budget check), and no duplicate/collinear degeneracies occur since the objective itself forbids them.
